source_note: Graph-expansion Phase 2 (docs/GRAPH_EXPANSION_DIRECTION.md plan section 5.2/section 15). Quotas and thresholds are public policy; which real candidates fill them each round is a private, per-round editorial decision (local/analysis/expansion/round-<n>/, data/private/ -- never this file).

automatic_lanes.note: Automatic (non-editorial) lanes: a candidate outside the roster band, or with fewer than overlap_existing_minimum distinct existing graph nodes on its roster, is never auto-selected -- it can still enter via the editorial lane on its own merits (e.g. a large ensemble), never hidden from the scoring packet.

collection_relaxation.note: Collection-sourced editorial candidates (owner's private Discogs collection) score under relaxed thresholds -- no roster band, overlap_existing >= 1 instead of >= 2 -- but still go through the same eligibility gate and the same scoring components as every other candidate. Membership in the collection never buys a slot by itself; the owner approves from the scored packet. Public label for every editorial pick, collection-sourced or not, is 'editorial' -- never 'personal_editorial' (ADR 0065's own correction).

round-1.quota_note: Owner's 2026-09-02 instruction: roughly 2/3 of Round 1's new albums are collection-sourced editorial picks. The editorial lane's 20 slots are expected to be mostly (not necessarily entirely) collection-sourced -- see the owner's own decision record in the plan's section 15.
